sidecar.dnsListTip: Single DNS server for the tunnel, e.g. 1.1.1.1.

sidecar.routeThroughXrayTip: Send tunnel client traffic through Xray so routing rules and outbounds apply.

sidecar.listenDtlsTip: host:port the qWDTT server listens on for clients.
sidecar.listenUdpTip: host:port the CSQTT server listens on for clients.
sidecar.configDirTip: Where qWDTT keeps passwords.json and wg-keys.dat. Defaults to a folder inside the panel data directory.
